resources.string: Sign in with an access token from Luna. Open Luna in a browser → Settings → Security → Create access token, then paste it here — or tap Scan QR code.
Photos save to Luna automatically. Choose when and where in Settings. Use Backup now to copy new photos without waiting.
On: wait for Wi-Fi that does not use mobile data. Off: any network, including mobile data. Backup now skips this wait.
On: wait until this phone is plugged in. Off: back up on battery too. Backup now skips this wait.
Photos go into the folder you pick, then year and month (for example Photos/2026/08).
What drive do you want to store your photos on?
Pick the drive on Luna where new photos should go. You choose the folder on the next screen.
Select the folder to store your photos in:
Luna requires a few permissions to run:
Luna reads photos stored on this phone so it can copy them to the folder you chose. It does not read videos, messages, or contacts.

On Android 13 and later, Luna shows a quiet notice while it is copying photos, and an alert if backup cannot continue — for example if the access token expired. It does not send other alerts. Older Android does not ask for this.

This is a system setting, not a permission Luna can grant itself. Android can pause apps that are set to Optimized, so photo backup may not run until you open Luna again. The next screen asks you to set Luna to Unrestricted (or Don\'t optimize). You can skip that screen and still use Luna; backup may then wait until you open the app.
Tap Grant. This phone will ask for photos (required), notifications (optional), then background access (optional).
Type only the folder name. You cannot type a path.
Enter a folder name, then tap Create.
Folder names cannot contain slashes, and cannot be a single dot or two dots. Pick a simple name.
Checking that Luna can save photos here…
This phone is asking for access…
Open the next screen and choose Unrestricted (or Don\'t optimize) for Luna. Then come back.
No drives found on Luna. Ensure that the drive is plugged in. If it is, try unplugging it and plugging it back in.
Tap a folder to open it, or Use this folder to choose the one you are in.
No folders here. You can still use this folder, or create a new one.
Tap a drive first, then Continue.
You\'re not signed in. Sign out, then sign in again with an access token from Luna → Settings → Security.
Photos still being copied from this phone to Luna.
Nothing is waiting to copy right now.
